name: Blind...
source:
The garden flowers had blossomed beautifully again this year. 
The sky was blue, and from faraway boys' voices could be heard. 

Rikka could only dream of the world beyond his window. He yearned to join those boys. 

His teacher would arrive in three minutes. 

Rikka, who had so often sat and stared wistfully out the window, 
was to reunited with a childhood friend named Mitsuaki. 
He remembered the boy being shy, but Mitsuaki had become 
a strict and strong-willed steward. 

He was not the Mitsuaki that Rikka remembered. 
It was a little unsettling, but Rikka dismissed the feeling. 

Perhaps he had truly changed, or perhaps it was a facade. 
It was hard to see the truth.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE107082.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
今年花园里的花又开得漂亮了。
天空很蓝，远处传来男孩子的声音。

立夏只能梦想着窗外的世界。他渴望加入那些男孩的行列。

他的老师三分钟后就会到达。

经常坐着若有所思地凝视窗外的立夏，
是为了与儿时好友光明重逢。
他记得那个男孩很害羞，但光明已经变得 
严格而意志坚强的管家。

他已经不是立夏记忆中的光明了。
虽然有点不安，但立夏却忽略了这种感觉。

或许他真的改变了，又或许只是表面的改变。
很难看到真相。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE107082.html]DLsite English[/url]]
